cause_definitions.answer_line_cutoff: a non-full prefix ends on a line beginning with `####`
cause_definitions.malformed_or_multi_candidate: a decoded text has multiple `####` candidates or a marker whose final candidate is rejected
cause_definitions.other_decoded_text: decoded strings differ without one of the named failure modes
cause_definitions.special_tokens: raw strings differ due to `<|...|>` markup and become equal under the production stripping policy
cause_definitions.unicode_digits: an answer candidate contains non-ASCII Unicode digits

decoder_policies.scoring_normalization: strip `<|...|>` special-token markup from both decoded strings
decoder_policies.vllm_raw: Qwen vLLM /detokenize response before markup stripping
